title: DYNAMIC SAFETY LAB: MEASURE, PREDICT, YIELD
subtitle: Learn how a robot reacts to anonymous moving actors without receiving their routes or identities.
briefing: MISSION: reach the first town gate with zero physical contact.
OBSERVE: moving vehicles are anonymous ROBOT tracks built from timed sensor measurements.
PROVE: prediction proposes a safe action, while Validator and Safety independently reject unsafe sweeps.

shots.title: THE ACTOR IS NOT AN ORACLE
shots.caption: SIM owns the actor body and authored route for scoring. ROBOT receives only anonymous measurements and its own dynamic tracks.

shots.title: PREDICTION STARTS WITH TIMESTAMPS
shots.caption: A moving obstacle is forecast from measured motion and uncertainty. Future script waypoints never cross the ROBOT boundary.

shots.title: YIELDING IS A VALID COMMAND
shots.caption: A safe hold or detour is selected through the same local map, swept envelope, Validator, and Safety chain as every other command.

shots.title: REACH THE GATE SAFELY
shots.caption: The mission verdict combines ROBOT completion with independent SIM contact and physical arrival evidence.

walkaround.title: ANONYMOUS MOVING ACTOR
walkaround.lesson: The rendered actor pose comes from MuJoCo body state, but ROBOT sees a measurement-derived track rather than an actor ID or route script.

walkaround.title: TIMED RANGE MEASUREMENTS
walkaround.lesson: Prediction quality depends on acquisition time, local geometry, and uncertainty; stale or missing scans must trigger a safe response.

walkaround.title: LOCAL SAFETY CONTRACT
walkaround.lesson: The local costmap and swept footprint validate every candidate before the chassis receives a command.

prediction.question: What should the robot do when an anonymous actor approaches the planned sweep?

choices.label: Slow or hold, then resume after measured clearance is safe
choices.explanation: The action is based on current tracks, prediction uncertainty, and the local safety envelope.

choices.label: Use the actor's authored route to pass first
choices.explanation: SIM actor identity and future script stay outside ROBOT.

choices.label: Keep speed because the map looks clear
choices.explanation: A static map cannot replace current dynamic measurements and the safety monitor.

running_prompt: Watch anonymous tracks, prediction horizon, local costmap, swept envelope, and the final safety command.

lessons: Actor identities and future scripts remain SIM-only; ROBOT reasons from measurements.
Prediction is evidence for planning, never permission to bypass Validator or Safety.
A safe hold is temporary evidence gathering; contact remains a hard physical failure.
